name: Yoga mat
summary: Yoga mat lying flat on the floor with a rolled-up end; anim unroll slides the mat out; use for yoga and fitness scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the mat sits on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 about 830 px wide (800 px mat plus the roll) and 260 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: unroll = the mat slides out of its roll over the first second

params.name: flip
params.note: roll on the left instead of the right

author: krakujs
